# talkdown

> talkdown is a small, no-install slide engine and Markdown format built for agents. A deck is one HTML file with Markdown in a `<script type="text/markdown">` block, loaded with deck.css and deck.js from a CDN. It presents as 16:9 slides and, on a phone or in read view, reads as an article where the speaker notes become the prose. Agents write it quickly and cheaply, and humans can edit it by hand.

For new decks, prefer `::: notes` / `::: say` / `::: read` and explicit `::: chart` containers. Use one HTML file by default; referenced Markdown is optional over HTTP. The public root `deck.js` and `deck.css` URLs remain the supported runtime links.

## Agent instructions

- [talkdown skill](https://sambhav.dev/talkdown/skills/talkdown/SKILL.md): how to write a deck: boilerplate, syntax, widgets, themes, rules, example. Read this first.
- [talkdown skill (jsDelivr)](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/sambhav/talkdown@main/skills/talkdown/SKILL.md): same file, via CDN.

## Docs and examples

- [README](https://github.com/sambhav/talkdown/blob/main/README.md): full syntax, widgets and themes.
- [Live demo](https://sambhav.dev/talkdown/): the demo deck, written in talkdown.
- [Starter deck](https://sambhav.dev/talkdown/examples/starter.html): a minimal template to copy.
